description.value: Field House Brewing Co. opened its original tasting room in East Abbotsford in 2016 and is known for a constantly rotating tap list spanning crushable ales, experimental IPAs, and funky barrel-aged sours, with at least one new beer released every week. The Abbotsford location features a laid-back patio and beer lawn alongside a farm-to-table canteen, weekly live music, and a community run club. Non-alcoholic beer options are also on tap, making it a genuinely welcoming stop for cyclists who may not be drinking.
